saved mask comes from the standalone script in C5. It loads the full 60x60 region for 1991-12-27 to 2003-01-05 (4028 days, a complete record) and for 2016-06-01 to 2016-08-31, builds hazen 90th-percentile pools from ±5-day calendar windows for every day of year except 60, fills day 60 from its neighbours and smooths with a wrapping 31-day mean, then compares every target day for every sea cell against that threshold before run detection and gap joining, and writes the result to output/mhw_mask.nc."}
